name: Example channel

audience.who: Curious adults who watch short explainer and story channels

promise: One short story, one thing you'll remember.

cast.personality: calm; politely challenges common wisdom with checked facts
running_gags: 'Partly.' - then where she respectfully disagrees with the common belief

tone_rules: conflict first, fact as the payoff
pay off the title in the first 3 seconds
no_go: health, finance or legal advice from a character

operating_model.shorts_per_episode: 2-3 vertical cuts from the long-form episode
retention_curve: pay off the title/thumbnail promise in the first 5 seconds
re-hook with a twist or a laugh about every third of the runtime
end right after the payoff - no long outro
operating_model.phase_1_target: 30-50 episodes before heavy optimisation (Paddy Galloway's phase 1)
